text: During the in-camera session of the Board of Management meeting in 2021, confidential minutes were taken, which are not made available to the public. The Zoo's auditors, KPMG, have requested a copy of these minutes as part of the year-end audit process.
The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Released the confidential minutes of the in-camera sessions of the 2021 Board of Management meetings to KPMG.
